title: GENERAL
officialText:
501.1 Scope. The provisions of this chapter shall govern certain alterations made to building
systems, elements or material that are limited in scope and or value, as set forth in the definition
of limited alteration in Chapter 2, and are limited to work described in Sections 503 through 510.
Such limited alterations shall comply with this chapter.
501.2 Applicant. In accordance with Section 28-104.6 of the Administrative Code, the applicant
for approval of construction documents for limited alterations may be other than a registered
design professional.
501.3 Additional categories of limited alterations. The commissioner may promulgate rules to
identify additional work of limited scope or value that is subject to this chapter.
